scope: F1-F4 preflight fixes + measurement harness development + T/H 10-trial smoke. No formal 1000-trial sampling, no final performance conclusions, no new lifecycle features.

F1_policy_gate.problem: PeerSnapshot.Matches accepted a revision argument but never used it, and admitSession checked only lifecycle/key ids/generation, so a Suite 1 session was admitted after the trusted minimum mode was raised to hybrid without changing keys
F1_policy_gate.fix: policy.ModeOf/Satisfies added and enforced in admitSession against the freshly read per-device MinimumMode; PeerSnapshot.Matches now compares the per-entry revision (not the whole-registry revision, so unrelated device updates do not reject unrelated sessions)
F1_policy_gate.tests: review regression TestReviewAdmissionAfterMinimumModeUpgrade upgrade=true (refused) and upgrade=false (positive control); the original N->N+1 and N+1-success tests are retained

F2_truncated_and_pending.problem: the gateway terminal switch folded err==nil, ErrPeerClosed and ErrTruncated into peer-closed with Incomplete=false, so a truncated stream and a close with an unacknowledged control were recorded as complete
F2_truncated_and_pending.fix: ErrTruncated -> terminated with ErrorStage=record and Incomplete=true (real error detail, no 'between frames'); a close is clean only when SentControls <= ConfirmedControls, otherwise Incomplete=true with the pending count in the detail; the clean-close positive control stays non-incomplete; the underlying wire.ErrTruncated classification was not weakened

F3_required_tri_state.problem: parse_m4_case validated tri-state values only when the key was present, so deleting business_accepted / plaintext_delivered / either channel_created still produced PASS
F3_required_tri_state.fix: one strict parser (parse_kv_case) shared by M4CASE and M2NEG: required string keys must be present and non-empty, required tri-state keys must be PRESENT (explicit null allowed, absence is not null), duplicate keys are rejected instead of silently overwritten, unknown keys preserved; unparseable marker lines are recorded as problems and make the run incomplete (non-zero exit)
F3_required_tri_state.real_data_effect: the guard immediately caught 5 emitters in internal/handshake that emitted empty or missing target/mutation; all were completed, and the full stream returned from INCOMPLETE to PASS
F3_required_tri_state.self_test: scripts/m4case_extractor_selftest.py, 45 checks including per-field deletion, reordering, extra fields, duplicate keys and M2NEG positives/negatives

F4_fleet_correlation.problem: the fleet verifier accepted a foreign operation_id that merely contained the device id, a confirmed sample_id that matched no telemetry, all business of one device collapsed into its first session, and a mismatched summary run_id; controls_sent was reported as the confirmed count even though no control-sent events existed
F4_fleet_correlation.fix: production emits a control-sent event right after ch.Send succeeds; the verifier correlates by (run_id, device_id, session_id, sample_id, operation_id), checks per-session volume, the exact per-session sample set, same-session telemetry-to-control pairing, emitter-format ownership of operation_id (not substring), sent/confirmed counted from their own events with controls_sent=null when no send evidence exists, and exactly one result row per expected device with boolean ok
F4_fleet_correlation.self_test: scripts/fleet_verifier_selftest.py, 19 checks (untampered PASS plus variants A-D, deleted send events, duplicated sample, missing good-device row)
F4_fleet_correlation.real_data: the untouched 20x3 evidence still verifies PASS with 60 unique session ids

harness.real_components: handshake.Client / Gateway / record / cryptosuite; no simplified handshake, no mock Channel
harness.isolation: every trial uses a fresh TCP connection and fresh ephemeral material; no downgrade, no session reuse
harness.status_file: RUNNING written first; PASS/FAIL/INCOMPLETE only from the real outcome, so a stale PASS cannot survive
harness.formal_mode: run-kind formal is explicitly refused with exit code 2; the fixed 1000-trial protocol is designed in docs/BENCHMARK_PLAN.md and stays locked

metrics.handshake_total_ns: device side, from immediately before ephemeral key generation to the return of handshake.Client (H4/Finished verified)
metrics.wire_bytes: counting Conn wrapper on the client connection, C->S and S->C separately, includes the 4-byte framing prefix, excludes IP/TCP kernel headers
metrics.cpu_per_trial: null + reason: per-trial isolation needs a subprocess harness; a process counter would attribute unrelated goroutine work to one handshake
metrics.peak_rss_per_trial: null + reason: not exposed by the Go standard library on this platform; a process peak must not be divided across trials
metrics.go_heap_alloc_bytes: measured and clearly labelled as a DIFFERENT metric from RSS

smoke.note: single host, single process, small scale; these numbers are not formal performance results and must not be quoted as competition data

verification_gaps: the race detector still cannot run on this machine; functional concurrency tests are NOT race-detector results
SM2 key agreement still has no independent implementation cross-check
P (public hybrid comparison) remains NOT IMPLEMENTED; a compatibility probe and the design only
not_claimed: a post-quantum secure system (SM2 identity authentication is not post-quantum)
a security audit or compliance certification
may_proceed_note: F1-F4 evidence closed, the harness runs real T/H measurements, smoke is credible, and the formal 1000-trial protocol is defined. M5B sampling stays locked until it is explicitly authorised.
